stat.$description: A single metric tile — one big number over a quiet label, in a bordered surface. The group-message delivery summary ('37 Delivered / 24 Seen / 6 Replied') is its driving use case; the analytics suite (MC v2 Part 4) will reuse it. Built on Card's own surface + hairline-border + radius recipe (no shadow), so a row of stats reads as a set of small cards. The value can carry a role color (e.g. Replied in success green) via the role axis; the label stays muted regardless.

value.$description: 24px bold — a prominent number, the tile's whole point.

label.$description: 13px — the metric's name under the number.

role.$description: Optional value tint — the number only, label stays muted. Reuses the semantic text.* role inks (600-step, AA-safe), so a stat means the same thing a Badge of that role would.
